title: Lemony Falafel Wrap
description: A crunchy and flavorful wrap filled with crispy falafel and a tangy lemon sauce. Serve as a snack or light meal.
instructions: 1. Preheat a pan with a small amount of oil over medium heat.
2. Add the falafel to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until crispy.
3. Warm the pita wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
4. Spread 1-2 tablespoons of leamy sauce on each pita wrap.
5. Add 2-3 falafel pieces to each wrap.
6. Top with crunchy lettuce, tomato, red onion, and cucumber.
